Verdict: OK to launch once BUG-01 is decided. Every wireframe change renders on all 4 browsers: new hero copy, 4 USPs, "Search Now", Google rating summary, the 14-review carousel, "Why Lotus?" removed, retitled grey fleet section, "Plan your trip" replacing "Before your trip", FAQ and footer unchanged. The V2 video is three spliced clips as requested. The one serious bug found during recon (V1 mobile showing control’s photo) is already fixed on live. All remaining failures are the issues listed below — no layout breakage, no JS errors from the variation, no horizontal scroll.

Open issues

BUG-01MediumV1 + V2 · All devices · tests: T13

"Plan your trip" shows the 4 newest blog posts, not the 4 in the wireframe

The code fetches /blog and takes the first 4 posts, so the section changes whenever a new post is published. Live today: Iceland in October 2026, What is the Best Month to Visit Iceland?, How Many Days Do You Need to Visit Iceland?, Is Iceland Expensive?. Wireframe: How Many Days…, Campervan vs Car Rental in Iceland, Renting a Car in Iceland with Kids, How to Rent a Car in Iceland. Only one matches.

Suggested fix: Client decision: if the wireframe posts are intended, hard-code those 4 slugs (fall back to latest if one is missing); if "latest" is intended, close as accepted.

BUG-02MediumV2 · All devices, mostly mobile data · tests: manual

Hero video is 23.6 MB and preloads in full on every device

1000200424_compressed.mp4 (1280×720, 45 s) is 23,572,027 bytes, and the video tag uses preload="auto" with no mobile variant. Phones on cellular download ~24 MB on the homepage, which will slow LCP and may skew the V2 result.

Suggested fix: Re-encode a smaller mobile version (e.g. 720p→480p, ~3–5 MB) served by a media query, or lazy-start the video after load; keep the poster image.

BUG-03LowV2 · All devices · tests: T03

Feature (USP) icons are different sizes in V2

V2 icons render at their natural SVG size: 20×20, 22×16, 20×20, 19×22 (V1 forces all four to 16×16 like the wireframe). The V2 Google rating badge also differs from V1 (209×40 vs 240×46 on desktop). The two variants should look identical apart from the background.

Suggested fix: Port V1’s ICON_STYLE / inline 16px sizing to va3.js, and match the rating icon height.

BUG-04LowV2 · All devices · tests: T18

Video ignores the "reduce motion" accessibility setting

With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the V2 video still autoplays. The guard exists in vB.js (where it is unused, since V1 is image mode) but was removed from va3.js.

Suggested fix: Restore the matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)") check in va3.js and show the static image instead.

BUG-05LowV1 + V2 · Desktop only · tests: T06

Screen readers still announce "Check the fleet" on the desktop CTA

The "Search Now" label is painted with CSS ::after on a font-size:0 button, so the button’s accessible name stays "Check the fleet" (WCAG 2.5.3 label-in-name). Mobile is fine — the site’s mobile button already says "Search Now".

Suggested fix: Add aria-label="Search Now" to [data-booking-element="check-fleet-desktop"] (and remove it in removeVariation).

BUG-06LowV1 + V2 · Code only · tests: manual

Code tidy-up: unclosed span, developer notes shipped in V2 CSS

Rating markup opens <span class="…hero-rating__icons"> and never closes it (the browser nests the text span inside it). va3.css ships "CSS CHANGES ONLY — 1) REPLACE… 2) REMOVE…" instructions and a duplicate .reviews__track rule — this is live.

Suggested fix: Close the span after the icon; delete the instruction comments and the duplicate rule.

Resolved during QA

FIXED-01Fixed on live

V1 mobile/tablet hero showed control’s own photo

At recon time (live code + local vB.js line 11) V1 below 1024px loaded afxmOcBOoF08xtoI_defender-lava-field-lake-aerial.jpg — the same image control uses. Live Convert code now has HERO_IMAGE_MOBILE = ".../test15/1.jpg"; re-verified at 390, 820 and 1000px and T04 passes on both phones. The local vB.js is stale — update it so it is not re-deployed.

Scope and method

  • Order followed: wireframes → vB.js/vB.css and va3.js/va3.css → live force URLs → Playwright spec (my-playwright-project/testing/lotus15-homepage-new-hero.spec.js) → this report.
  • Browsers (as requested): Chrome desktop (1280×720), Safari desktop (WebKit), Chrome mobile (Pixel 5), Safari mobile (iPhone 12). Runs went one browser at a time to avoid memory kills.
  • Covered: arm/body-class and Convert assignment, hero copy, USPs, hero media (image / video playing, muted, looping, inline), CTA label and accessible name, rating link, review section position and count, carousel arrows/dots/swipe, Read more / Show less, fleet title and background, Plan your trip content, links and images, SPA navigation away and Back (variation cleaned up and re-applied with no duplicates), Search Now booking flow, FAQ accordion and footer, horizontal overflow, German homepage exclusion, reduced motion.
  • Test-side noise filtered: WebKit cross-origin errors from the site’s Prismic and menni.ai chatbot iframes and from Next.js ?_rsc= prefetches (site-level, all arms). The site’s 403 console errors appear on control too.
  • Co-running Convert experiences on the homepage: 100052977 (cre-t-18) everywhere and 100052832 (cre-t-17) on mobile. No visual conflict seen.
  • Not covered: real iOS/macOS Safari hardware (Playwright WebKit used), tablet-specific layout (spot-checked at 820/1000px only), Convert goal tracking (none specified in the ticket).
